scripts.db:reset: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && psql $DATABASE_URL -c 'DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;' && psql $DATABASE_URL -f src/schemas/main.sql && psql $DATABASE_URL -f src/schemas/staging.sql
scripts.build: REGISTRY=$(terraform -chdir=../../terraform output -raw artifact_registry_repo) && docker build -t $REGISTRY/timetables:latest . && docker push $REGISTRY/timetables:latest
